verdict.rationale: The CLI documents `skills ls` (npm-ls-style listing of installed skills) and `skills remove` (with agent/skill targeting), and the symlink-based install strategy (canonical copy + per-agent symlinks) implies clean removal without duplicated files. However, there is no first-party evidence describing what remove actually cleans up (e.g. confirmation that symlinks, lockfile entries, and generated prompt text are all deleted), and a community comment explicitly complains that this class of tool doesn't document uninstall/version-pinning behavior clearly, which weighs against full confidence though it doesn't show a concrete hands-on failure. missing for 10: documented/verified proof that `skills remove` deletes all associated files (symlinks, lockfile entries, agent-specific copies) with no orphaned instructions left behind, and independent hands-on confirmation of clean uninstall.
